fullPassage: A new Yale study reveals that searching the web provides people with an "illusion of knowledge." They start to confuse what's online with what's in their head, which gives them an exaggerated sense of their own smarts. The researchers divided test subjects into two groups. One group spent time searching the web, the other stayed offline, and then both groups estimated, in a variety of ways, their understanding of various topics. The experiments consistently showed that searching the web deludes people into believing they know more than they really do. The effect held, the researchers report, "even after controlling for time, content, and features of the search process." The effect isn't limited to the particular subjects people explore online. It's more general than that. Doing searches on one topic inflates people's sense of how well they understand other, unrelated topics. To make sure that the searchers' overconfidence stemmed from a misperception of the depth of knowledge in their own heads (rather than reflecting a trust in Google's ability to deliver relevant knowledge), the psychologists, in one of the experiments, had the test subjects make estimates of their brain activity. Those who had been searching the net before the task rated their brain activity as being significantly stronger than did the control group that hadn't been looking up information online. Similar misperceptions may be produced by consulting other sources of information, the researchers note, but the illusion is probably much stronger with the web, given its unprecedented scope. Unlike earlier stores of knowledge such as books and libraries, "the Internet is nearly always accessible, can be searched efficiently, and provides immediate feedback." As a result, the net likely becomes more "integrated with the human mind" and promotes "much stronger illusions of knowledge."

❌ ③ reveals — lessens — accessible (B 반대: 부풀리다→줄이다)

Unlike earlier stores of knowledge such as books and libraries, "the Internet is nearly always accessible, can be searched efficiently, and provides immediate feedback." As a result, the net likely becomes more "integrated with the human mind" and promotes "much stronger illusions of knowledge."

questions.passage:
(A) The researchers were careful about the <u>content</u> of each search, checking exactly what information appeared on the screen. They wanted every topic to be treated fairly.

(B) After finally finishing the long and difficult task, she felt completely <u>content</u> and leaned back with a quiet smile.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 content의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) the content of each search = 각 검색의 '내용' (명사) / (B) felt content = '만족한'(형용사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① 내용 — 만족한 ←정답
❌ ② 만족한 — 내용 (A와 B가 뒤바뀜)
❌ ③ 내용 — 용기 (B는 '용기'가 아니라 '만족한')
❌ ④ 논쟁 — 만족한 (A는 '논쟁'이 아니라 '내용')
det.tip: content(명사)=내용 / content(형용사)=만족한. 문맥으로 품사와 뜻을 구분

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to describe or represent something as larger, better, or worse than it really is"

det.korean: 실제보다 더 크거나 좋거나 나쁘게 묘사하다 → exaggerate (과장하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① minimize — 최소화하다 (반대 뜻)
❌ ② ignore — 무시하다 (무관)
✅ ③ exaggerate — 과장하다 ←정답
❌ ④ repeat — 반복하다 (무관)
det.tip: exaggerate = 실제보다 부풀려 말하다(과장하다)

questions.passage: The experiments consistently showed that searching the web __________ (delude) people into believing they know more than they really do. The effect isn't limited to the particular subjects people explore online.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 빈칸의 주어는 'searching the web(웹을 검색하는 것)'예요. 동명사 주어는 하나로 취급하므로 3인칭 단수예요. 그래서 현재시제 동사에 -s를 붙여 deludes로 써요.
det.analysis:
주어 searching the web = 동명사(하나)로 단수 취급 → 현재시제 3인칭 단수 → delude에 -s를 붙여 deludes

'웹 검색이 사람들을 착각하게 만든다'는 일반적 사실이라 현재시제로 써요.
det.tip: 동명사 주어(searching the web)는 단수 → deludes

questions.passage: Those who had been __________ (search) the net before the task rated their brain activity as being significantly stronger than did the control group. Similar misperceptions may be produced by consulting other sources of information.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 'had been + 동사원형' 형태는 없어요. 'had been' 뒤에는 -ing를 붙여 '과거완료 진행형(그전부터 계속 ~하고 있던)'을 만들어요. 그래서 searching으로 써요.
det.analysis:
had been __________ → had been + V-ing(과거완료 진행형) 자리 → search에 -ing를 붙여 searching

'과제 전에 그동안 계속 검색해 오던 사람들'이라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: had been + V-ing = 과거완료 진행형 → searching
